\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs of change and movement — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R175-first-pass-verbs-of-change-and-movement}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to burn and to put out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to accept, to mix, to change, to drive, to leave
  \item to join, to reduce, to increase, to save, to escape
  \item to die, to live, to pass, to lift, to tell
  \item to show, to be seen, to hide, to hide, to stop
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To accept? (\textbf{\hi{मानना}}, \emph{mānnā}.) To mix? (\textbf{\hi{मिलाना}}, \emph{milānā}.) To change? (\textbf{\hi{बदलना}}, \emph{badalnā}.) To drive? (\textbf{\hi{चलाना}}, \emph{calānā}.) To leave? (\textbf{\hi{छोड़ना}}, \emph{choṛnā}.) To join? (\textbf{\hi{जोड़ना}}, \emph{joṛnā}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\hi{घटाना}}, \emph{ghaṭānā}.) To increase? (\textbf{\hi{बढ़ाना}}, \emph{baṛhānā}.) To save? (\textbf{\hi{बचाना}}, \emph{bacānā}.) To escape? (\textbf{\hi{बचना}}, \emph{bacnā}.) To die? (\textbf{\hi{मरना}}, \emph{marnā}.) To live? (\textbf{\hi{जीना}}, \emph{jīnā}.) To pass? (\textbf{\hi{बीतना}}, \emph{bītnā}.) To lift? (\textbf{\hi{उठाना}}, \emph{uṭhānā}.) To tell? (\textbf{\hi{सुनाना}}, \emph{sunānā}.) To show? (\textbf{\hi{दिखाना}}, \emph{dikhānā}.) To be seen? (\textbf{\hi{दिखना}}, \emph{dikhnā}.) To hide? (\textbf{\hi{छिपाना}}, \emph{chipānā}.) To hide? (\textbf{\hi{छिपना}}, \emph{chipnā}.) To stop? (\textbf{\hi{रुकना}}, \emph{ruknā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs of the hands and the kitchen — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R175-second-pass-verbs-of-the-hands-and-the-kitchen}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to stop and to run away.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to stop, to run away, to climb, to get down, to stroll
  \item to cover, to fill, to share, to choose, to ask for
  \item to give back, to decorate, to look after, to improve, to weigh
  \item to measure, to drop, to light, to burn, to put out
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To stop? (\textbf{\hi{रोकना}}, \emph{roknā}.) To run away? (\textbf{\hi{भागना}}, \emph{bhāgnā}.) To climb? (\textbf{\hi{चढ़ना}}, \emph{caṛhnā}.) To get down? (\textbf{\hi{उतरना}}, \emph{utarnā}.) To stroll? (\textbf{\hi{घूमना}}, \emph{ghūmnā}.) To cover? (\textbf{\hi{ढकना}}, \emph{ḍhaknā}.) To fill? (\textbf{\hi{भरना}}, \emph{bharnā}.) To share? (\textbf{\hi{बाँटना}}, \emph{bā̃ṭnā}.) To choose? (\textbf{\hi{चुनना}}, \emph{cunnā}.) To ask for? (\textbf{\hi{माँगना}}, \emph{mā̃gnā}.) To give back? (\textbf{\hi{लौटाना}}, \emph{lauṭānā}.) To decorate? (\textbf{\hi{सजाना}}, \emph{sajānā}.) To look after? (\textbf{\hi{सँभालना}}, \emph{sãbhālnā}.) To improve? (\textbf{\hi{सुधारना}}, \emph{sudhārnā}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\hi{तोलना}}, \emph{tolnā}.) To measure? (\textbf{\hi{नापना}}, \emph{nāpnā}.) To drop? (\textbf{\hi{गिराना}}, \emph{girānā}.) To light? (\textbf{\hi{जलाना}}, \emph{jalānā}.) To burn? (\textbf{\hi{जलना}}, \emph{jalnā}.) To put out? (\textbf{\hi{बुझाना}}, \emph{bujhānā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
